Since n, j, and x were arbitrary under the stated hypotheses, this is exactly the theorem.

lemmas.statement_nl: Let n be a positive integer and j an integer with 0 <= j <= n - 1. For every real x in I_{n,j}, there is exactly one real d in [0, 1/n) such that x = J_{n,j}(d), namely d = x - j/n.
lemmas.strictly_easier_reason: This is an affine-coordinate uniqueness statement, separate from the function inequality.
